title: Confession and Cipher
author: Quentin Okonkwo
blurb: Jude Oyelaran, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
